page.title: Leads
page.description: Sales enquiries captured from calls or logged by your team, tracked to won or lost.

open.title: No open leads
open.description: Sales enquiries your agent captures on calls will show up here.

won.title: No won leads yet
won.description: Leads that turn into work land here.

lost.title: Nothing lost
lost.description: Leads that don't work out land here.

all.title: No leads yet
all.description: Log your first lead, or let your agent capture them from calls.

noMatch.title: No leads match
noMatch.description: Try a different search or clear some filters.

stats.openLeads: {count, plural, one {# open lead} other {# open leads}}
stats.openLeadsWithNew: {count, plural, one {# open lead} other {# open leads}} · {newCount, number} new
stats.wonAllTime: {count, plural, one {# lead} other {# leads}} won all time
stats.winRateDetail: {won, number} of {decided, plural, one {# closed lead} other {# closed leads}}, last 90 days
stats.noClosedLeads: No closed leads in the last 90 days

filters.searchLabel: Search leads by title or contact name

detail.noneSelectedDescription: Select a lead to see its details and history.
detail.notFoundMessage: This lead doesn't exist or was removed.
detail.markedAs: Lead marked as {status, select, contacted {contacted} qualified {qualified} other {{status}}}

timeline.title: Activity
timeline.placeholder: Add a note — calls made, follow-ups, pricing…
timeline.label: Add a note to this lead
timeline.empty: Nothing yet — notes and status changes will show up here.

form.newDescription: Log a sales enquiry for the team to follow up.
form.editDescription: Update the details — status changes happen from the lead's actions.
form.title: Title
form.titlePlaceholder: What they're after, e.g. Kitchen rewire
form.valueHint: Rough worth of the work, in shekels.
form.notesPlaceholder: What they asked for, budget, timing… (optional)

markWon.title: Mark this lead as won?
markWon.description: Closes “{title}” as won. You can reopen it later if things change.
markWon.descriptionWithValue: Closes “{title}” as won and counts {value} toward the month's total. You can reopen it later if things change.

markLost.title: Mark this lead as lost
markLost.description: Closes “{title}” without a win. You can reopen it later if the contact comes back.
markLost.descriptionNamed: Closes “{title}” without a win. You can reopen it later if {name} comes back.
markLost.reasonHint: Optional — added to the lead's timeline.

reopen.title: Reopen this lead?
reopen.description: Puts “{title}” back in the pipeline as Contacted.
reopen.descriptionWon: Puts “{title}” back in the pipeline as Contacted and removes it from the won totals.

convert.title: Convert this lead to a job?
convert.description: Creates a job for “{title}” with the contact attached, ready to schedule. The lead stays here with its history.
convert.descriptionNamed: Creates a job for “{title}” with {name} attached, ready to schedule. The lead stays here with its history.

delete.title: Delete this lead?
delete.description: “{title}” and its activity timeline are removed for good. Mark it lost instead if you want to keep the history.
